'''Targot Jinglepocket''' is a [[goblin]] [[food]] and [[drink]] [[vendor]] located in [[Refuge Pointe]] in the [[Arathi Highlands]].

==Trivia==
*Like all [[Smokywood Pastures]] merchants, Targot is named after a large store chain, in his case, the mass merchandise retailer {{wplink|Target Corporation|Target}}.
